recs.stt: Quantum theory based on real numbers can be experimentally falsified
recs.x: There is a nice 10 minute discussion about this paper by physicist Sabine Hossenfelder on her "Science without the gobbelydgook" [link] series (which I recommend). She considers the existential questions regarding necessity of complex numbers a "super-niche nerd fight". You can find the video here [link] .
